authority_rule: Inventory only. Existing Fabrication Router, vf-3d-router, CreativeCraft and Blender Capability Host remain authorities; this file grants no new authority.

selection_policy: Use the smallest tool chain that can produce and verify the requested result.
Use native reasoning for advice, calculations, tolerances, requirements and tradeoffs when no geometry artifact or exact measurement is required.
Use native vision to interpret a user photo or sketch before CAD, but never treat pixels as dimensional truth for hidden or critical dimensions.
Use cad for deterministic functional geometry, exact edits, assemblies and STEP/STL/3MF/GLB artifacts.
Use 3D AI Studio instead of cad for organic/sculptural/generative forms when a mesh is the natural representation; hand the result to dfam-check before printing.
Search step-parts before inventing placeholder geometry for named off-the-shelf hardware or components.
Use cad-viewer after creating or materially editing CAD/robot-description/DXF artifacts when visual review adds value.
Use dfam-check before first slicing of a new or materially changed additive part; use its orientation analysis when supports, overhangs or build orientation matter.
Use gcode only after a slice-ready mesh exists; VelvetPrintLab printer_matrix.json remains the printer/profile authority.
Use engineering-drawing for dimensioned manufacturing PDFs, not as a substitute for DXF cut geometry.
Use dxf for 2D profiles, flat patterns, templates and cut layouts.
Use dfm for CNC, sheet-metal or injection-molding manufacturability, not for FDM printability.
Use urdf/srdf/sdf only for robot/simulation descriptions.
Use sendcutsend only for SendCutSend preflight/readiness; never place or submit an order.
If an exact artifact request cannot be completed with the selected specialized tool, fail closed or choose a semantically equivalent verified route; do not silently approximate with prose.
